units.source_text: 源氏所写的册子，无法隐藏，便取出来共同欣赏。

en.t: The booklets Genji had written could not be kept hidden, so they were brought out for everyone to admire together.

units.source_text: 写在平整的中国纸上的草体字，萤兵部卿亲王看了觉得特别优越。

en.t: Seeing the cursive writing on smooth Chinese paper, Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War, thought it especially superb.

units.source_text: 又有高丽纸，纹理细致，柔软可爱，色泽并不鲜丽，而有优雅之感。

en.t: There was also Korean paper, finely textured, soft and charming; its color was not bright, but it had an elegant feeling.

units.source_text: 上面写着流丽的假名，笔笔正确，处处用心，其美无可比拟。

en.t: On it were written flowing kana, every stroke precise and every detail carefully considered, with a beauty beyond compare.

units.source_text: 观者似觉跟着书家的笔尖而流着感动之泪，真乃百看不厌的佳作。

en.t: The viewer seemed to follow the calligrapher's brush tip and shed tears of emotion; it was truly a masterpiece one could look at endlessly.

units.source_text: 又有本国制的彩色纸屋纸，

en.t: There was also colored Kamiya paper made in their own country,

units.source_text: 色泽鲜艳的纸面上信笔率书着草体字的诗歌，其美亦无限量。

en.t: and on the vividly colored sheets, poems in cursive script had been written freely and casually, their beauty also beyond measure.

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王看了源氏这种随意挥洒、妩媚动人的手迹，爱不忍释，更不想看别人的作品了。

en.t: When Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War, saw Genji's relaxed yet alluring handwriting, he loved it too much to put it down and no longer wished to look at anyone else's work.
